name: Four zones · aggressive hold
description: Channel A only: depth picks one of four patterns around your carrier; hold deep and still to unlock aggressive mode
author: ShockingVRC

nodes.title: READ ME · how to set up

kind.text:
ONE CHANNEL (A), FOUR ZONES + AGGRESSIVE MODE. The contact depth is split into four zones and each zone plays its own frequency and intensity pattern on all four 25 ms segments of channel A. Channel B is not used.
HOW TO SET IT UP
1. Bind your Coyote to Device 1. Set 'Max output power' LOW first (it is Limit Max of channel A — the Graph cap in Setup still wins), then raise it while touching.
2. Pick your 'Carrier frequency': every segment frequency is Carrier ± up to 'Max frequency deviation' (both directions, a hard bound). Low carrier = thumps, high carrier = buzz.
3. Pick 'Base intensity' and 'Max intensity deviation': every segment intensity stays inside Base ± deviation.
4. Zone tempo sliders speed each zone's pattern up or down (1 = as designed).
5. Aggressive mode: go past 0.8 and hold still. Watch the left scope: when the orange |velocity| line stays under the threshold line, the dwell bar in the right scope fills; after 'Dwell time' it switches on. Raise 'Stillness threshold' if it never arms, lower it if it arms while you move. It stops 'Release delay' seconds after you leave 0.8–1 or start moving, and instantly if the contact is released.
6. 'Test aggressive' (hold) previews the aggressive pattern while touching; 'Aggressive enabled' turns the mode off entirely.

SETTINGS — every knob of the preset lives here. Power: Max output power = Limit Max (0–100). Pattern power depth: 0 = power follows depth only, 1 = the active zone's texture (swell, steps, surge) also shapes power. Frequency/intensity: carrier and base are the centre; deviations are the maximum swing in BOTH directions. Aggressive: dwell, stillness, release, extra power (added to Limit Max only while aggressive) and its tempo.

ZONES — raw contact depth, no smoothing. Compare ≥ 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.8 (±0.01 hysteresis so a boundary does not chatter) summed = zone 0–3. Each Remap gives the position inside its zone (0–1) so every pattern still follows small depth changes. The UKF only supplies velocity and speed.

AGGRESSIVE LATCH — Armed = in zone 4 AND |UKF velocity| < threshold AND enabled. The Ramp Timer must stay armed for the dwell time (any movement resets it). Peak Hold keeps it on for the release delay after the conditions break, then fades in 0.25 s. If you settle again inside that window (still for 0.35 s, 'Re-settled') it carries on without a new dwell — but the brief stop at the turn of every stroke is too short to count, so steady strokes always let it go.

PATTERNS — each group outputs 4 frequency shapes and 4 intensity shapes in −1…+1 plus a power texture. Each segment has its own resting offset, so the gaps between segments are all different, and its own shape/phase; noise drift and your motion bend every rate so nothing loops.
Zone 1 · 0–0.2 Ripple: slow smooth waves, soft.   Zone 2 · 0.2–0.4 Staircase: stepped melodies 5/6/7/9 long, random intensity steps.
Zone 3 · 0.4–0.8 Surge: rising chirps, intensity throbs, deeper = longer on-time.   Zone 4 · 0.8–1 Storm: fast chaotic flutter, strong.
Aggressive: hard zig-zag at the extremes, near-max intensity, short gaps. Open a group (double-click) to edit offsets, shapes and rates.

OUTPUT — Switches pick the active pattern (zone, or 4 = aggressive). Remap turns −1…+1 into Carrier ± deviation (Hz) and Base ± deviation, clamped, so the sliders are hard limits. Power = Curve(depth) — a different slope per zone, continuous at the edges, no hold — times the zone texture (by depth slider), or full while aggressive. Edit the Curve to reshape the power response.
